sources.scope: 查證具名案例與原理背景。課內數值、故障資料與判準為原創教學假設；請勿當作廠商規格或操作程序。

related.title: ECMP：流雜湊偏斜與位元組加權
related.titleEn: ECMP: flow hashing skew and byte weighting
related.why: 用兩課的可觀察驗收條件比較模型邊界：第5項研究的可複查條件：接受正餘裕且實際安裝的候選；將link protection與node protection另列。 交接時須能核對：交付 lfa-distances.csv、嚴格邊界測試與備援安裝核對。
related.whyEn: Compare model boundaries using observable acceptance criteria: Investigation 5 review criterion: Accept positive-margin installed candidates and distinguish link from node protection. Handover must also reconcile: Deliver lfa-distances.csv, strict-boundary tests and backup-install checks.
related.difference: 以五元組、bucket、bytes建立流表，將同一流的所有封包放在同一桶。
related.differenceEn: Build five-tuple, bucket and byte columns, keeping packets of each flow in one bucket.
related.transfer: 保留單位與邊界條件，僅轉移可證明相容的驗證方法。
related.transferEn: Retain units and boundary conditions; transfer only demonstrably compatible verification methods.
practice:
Loop-Free Alternate需滿足距離不等式；備援鄰居存在並不保證不繞回來源。
教學基準：3+6-7 = 2 cost margin；對照：3+6-9 = 0 cost margin。所有數值、事件、期限與門檻是本課明示的合成教學情境，並非官方設備規格、營運網路量測或部署建議。

ECMP可按流雜湊分配；流數均勻不代表位元組均勻，重新映射也會影響既有流。
教學基準：40/(100/4) = 1.6 peak/mean；對照：25/(100/4) = 1 peak/mean。所有數值、事件、期限與門檻是本課明示的合成教學情境，並非官方設備規格、營運網路量測或部署建議。
比較兩個模型的輸入、誤差與驗收條件，記錄不能沿用的假設。
practiceEn:
A Loop-Free Alternate must satisfy a distance inequality; an available neighbor does not guarantee avoidance of the source.
Teaching baseline: 3+6-7 = 2 cost margin; comparison: 3+6-9 = 0 cost margin. All numeric inputs, events, timers and limits are explicit synthetic teaching conditions, not official equipment specifications, operational-network measurements or deployment recommendations.

ECMP can hash by flow; equal flow counts do not imply equal bytes, and remapping affects established flows.
Teaching baseline: 40/(100/4) = 1.6 peak/mean; comparison: 25/(100/4) = 1 peak/mean. All numeric inputs, events, timers and limits are explicit synthetic teaching conditions, not official equipment specifications, operational-network measurements or deployment recommendations.
Compare inputs, errors, and criteria; document assumptions that cannot be transferred.
